SCORE_HOW_TO.TITLE: How to get MusicXML from printed Scores
SCORE_HOW_TO.STEP_1: Install Audiveris, a music recognition tool.
SCORE_HOW_TO.STEP_2: Open the PDF or the scan of your Score in Audiveris and let it recognise the Notes.
SCORE_HOW_TO.STEP_3: Check and correct the result in a notation program such as MuseScore.
SCORE_HOW_TO.STEP_4: Export the Score as MusicXML (.musicxml, .xml or .mxl).
